instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup all-purpose flour
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cube steak, add to bowl, and toss to coat.
Wash and dry potatoes, carrots, celery, and green onions. Peel and medium dice potatoes and carrots. Trim ends and medium dice celery. Trim root ends and chop onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of saucepan with oil. Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes total.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onions, and garlic. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, water, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until vegetables are tender, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 ¼ cups water
3 tbsp soy sauce
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast bread.
To serve, place stew in a bowl and have with crusty bread. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
Peel and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 4-5 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, fill another large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Use the tip of a knife to slice down the length of each sausage. Peel off the casings and discard. Add sausage meat to the pot with the onions and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic.
Add garlic, tomato sauce, water, sugar, and spices to the pot with the sausage and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 cup water
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the other pot is boiling, add cauliflower and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan and set aside.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the ragú and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower and ragú between plates or bowls. Garnish with Parmesan and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the spinach and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and onion.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 1-2 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat and set aside. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Place ricotta, eggs, and spices in the reserved bowl; whisk until smooth. Add the cooked spinach and half the basil (reserving the rest for garnish), and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
3 eggs
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate mozzarella.

Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and coat the bottom with oil. Transfer half the cauliflower to the skillet and spread it out in an even layer. Spoon half the ricotta mixture over the cauliflower, followed by half the tomato sauce and mozzarella. Repeat process once more, creating two layers.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and cauliflower is heated through, about 15 minutes.
To serve, divide cauliflower bake between plates and garnish with reserved basil. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
9 baby bok choy
3 red bell peppers
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the onion and garlic; add coconut aminos and almond butter. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp coconut aminos
3 tbsp natural almond butter

instructions.primary_message: Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Trim and thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and stir-fry until just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for the next step.)
Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies to the pot and stir-fry until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add sauce, steak (and any accumulated juices), and cilantro to the pot; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and steak is warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide stir-fry and sauce between plates or bowls; top with almonds and enjoy!

Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix well and form into 6 patties.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
⅜ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tsp soy sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in pan. Add beef patties and cook until browned and almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once patties have been transferred, add more butter and onion to pan. Stirring frequently, cook until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, and thyme to pan. Stirring occasionally, cook until mushrooms are tender, 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour and broth until smooth. Add to pan and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp all-purpose flour
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Return beef patties and any juices to pan. Cover and simmer until gravy thickens and steaks are cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add butter, broth, ½ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place mashed potatoes on a plate and top with steaks and gravy. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a large bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the veggie ground is done, add veggies and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 5-6 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml almond milk, unsweetened
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1-2 minutes more.

Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and soy sauce to the pot with the veggie ground; stir to combine the veggie filling and bring to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat and transfer filling to a large baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ cups frozen peas
2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Spoon mashed potatoes over the veggie filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place baking dish in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the bake between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
3 Granny Smith apples
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: While the sausages are cooking, place ketchup, water, soy sauce, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl; add mayo, water, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup vegan mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl.
Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface and top each with a small portion of slaw; arrange sausage slices on top and drizzle with sauce. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates; serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
3 limes
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
3 bunches radish
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, quarter, and core apples; roughly chop and place in a blender.

Add ketchup, water, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the blender with the apple. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is smooth, adding water a few tablespoons at a time, if needed, to reach a saucy consistency; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup ketchup
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup soy sauce
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tofu, thread onto skewers, and transfer to a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the tofu directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, coat skewers with half of the sauce. (Reserve remaining sauce for the next step.)

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until the tofu is lightly charred and warmed through, 6-8 minutes. Return to the plate and coat with remaining sauce.
Meanwhile, juice limes into a large bowl, then add oil, mayo, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp vegan mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve snap peas; trim and thinly slice radishes. Add both to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the pine nuts, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide BBQ tofu skewers and salad between plates. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 (170 g) pkgs raspberries
3 red bell peppers
3 small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into a blender.
Peel garlic; add to the blender with the orange juice along with raspberries, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and spices. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is very smooth, 1-2 minutes; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp soy sauce
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; place on a plate. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add tofu and grill, flipping once, until charred and warmed through, 5-7 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers crosswise into 1-inch wide strips; place in a large bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the tofu is done, working in batches if necessary, add veggies to the pan; grill, flipping once, until tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the bowl.

To assemble, cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; spread each pocket with 1 tablespoon of the BBQ sauce. Stuff with tofu and drizzle with another 1 tablespoon of the sauce. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Divide pitas and grilled veggies between plates; serve with remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add mushrooms, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour into the skillet; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, 1-2 minutes.

Add milk and soy sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gravy has thickened, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml almond milk, unsweetened
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the oranges, then cut into wedges.
Toast buns if desired.
Divide buns between plates and top with gravy; serve with orange wedges on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).
Wash, dry, and quarter potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add veggie ground and spices to the pot. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground is cooking, coarsely grate mozzarella.

When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the pot with the veggie ground and onions. Gently crush some of the potatoes using a fork or potato masher. Add broth to the pot and stir to combine. (Reserve pot used for the potatoes for later use.)
Transfer veggie ground mixture to a large baking dish. Sprinkle mozzarella over the veggie ground and potatoes.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Return the pot to medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide veggie ground-potato bake and spinach between plates. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, curry paste, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms start to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tofu.
Once the soup is boiling, uncover, add tofu and rice noodles, then stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
When the noodles are almost soft, add green beans. Continue to cook until noodles and beans are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Wash, dry, and juice limes into the soup. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more.
When the pasta and broccoli are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add beans and Alfredo sauce, then toss to combine.
Return pot to medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.

When the veggies are soft, add beans, broth, tomatoes, and spices to the pot; stir to combine. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until flavors blend, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
¼ cup taco seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls. Top with cheese and chips. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
170 g tortilla chips

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat the bottom of two large baking dishes with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans. Place in a large bowl.
Add yogurt, taco seasoning, and salt to the bowl with the beans. Stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup taco seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, place tortillas on a flat surface and divide the filling between them. Wrap tortillas around the filling and divide between the baking dishes, placing seam-side down. Top with salsa and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 small corn tortillas
2 cup salsa
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cheese is melted and filling is warmed through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a clean large bowl. (Set remaining cilantro aside for serving.)
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Add shredded cabbage, dressing, and salt to the bowl. Stir to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
⅓ cup ranch dressing
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide enchiladas and slaw between plates; sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the water is boiling, add broccoli, edamame, noodles, and salt; cook until veggies and noodles are tender, 5-6 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under warm water (from the tap); set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
4 ½ cups edamame
425 g soba (buckwheat) noodles
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice limes into a large bowl.
Add miso paste, vinegar, water, oil, and soy sauce to the bowl with the lime juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup miso paste, white
⅓ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add broccoli, edamame, noodles, and carrots to the bowl. Toss to combine.
To serve, divide noodles, edamame, and veggies between bowls; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl along with the snap peas.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Place broth, coconut milk, curry paste, and salt in a large pot; stir to combine. Bring the curry to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the curry heats up, drain and rinse beans.
Once the curry is simmering, add veggies and beans to the pot; stir to combine. Return curry to a simmer and continue to cook until veggies are soft and beans are warmed through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the curry, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide rice and curry between plates or bowls; serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Place mayo, dressing, and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup Caesar dressing
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing. Mash with a fork or potato masher until combined and chickpeas are crushed, but still have some texture.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
3 green bell peppers
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Add Parmesan to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add additional garlic powder and salt; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chickpea salad, then top with bread crumbs and additional Parmesan. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Drain and rinse beans.
Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans; evenly spread with barbecue sauce, then top with beans and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain pitas
¾ cup barbecue sauce
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until pita pizzas are golden and cheese is melted, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve cucumbers lengthwise; cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a large bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
Cut pizzas into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
Drain and rinse beans. Add to remaining bowl with the cilantro along with cheese and taco seasoning. Stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans pinto beans
1 cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend
¼ cup taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Stuff pepper halves with the filling, then top with additional cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil the peppers until filling is warmed through and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens, carrots, and dressing to the second bowl with the cilantro. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates; top each pepper with a dollop of guacamole. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; halve crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Place in a large bowl along with the butternut squash and edamame.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
6 cup frozen butternut squash, pieces
4 ½ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper, squash, and edamame.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add edamame and veggies, then cover with a lid; cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 5-6 minutes.
Add stir-fry sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the lemon.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

When the pasta is almost done, add beans and kale to the pot, then stir for a few seconds. Continue to cook until beans are warmed through, kale is tender, and pasta reaches desired doneness, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta, beans, and kale. Return to the pot along with the lemon, tomato, basil, dressing, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup Italian salad dressing
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Set pot over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until tomatoes are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F) and place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Wash, dry, and trim each squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the upper and middle racks of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a large baking dish.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the baking dish with the chickpeas. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Pour marinara sauce over the chickpeas, season with garlic powder, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (680 g) jars marinara sauce
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish on the lower rack of the oven and bake until chickpeas are tender and sauce is warmed through, 10-12 minutes.
When the squash is done, remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
While the squash cools, remove chickpeas from the oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return baking dish to the oven and continue to bake until cheese is melted, 6-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and "chickpea Parmesan" between plates or bowls; top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 red bell peppers
6 oranges

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with stir-fry and hoisin sauces. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup stir-fry sauce
⅓ cup hoisin sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl along with the shredded cabbage.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cups edamame
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Crush tortilla chips into small pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 hearts romaine hearts
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 peaches
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans in the colander. Add to the bowl along with almonds, vinaigrette, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans
1 cup almonds, sliced
1 cup French vinaigrette
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into ½-inch thick strips. Divide between two large baking sheets along with broccoli. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
¼ cup toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice oranges into a large bowl. Add hoisin sauce and additional oil, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
1 cup hoisin sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu. Add to the bowl with the sauce and stir to coat.
When the veggies have started to soften, remove from the oven. Add tofu and sauce to the baking sheets; stir to combine with the veggies, then spread out in an even layer.
Return the baking sheets to the oven and continue to bake until veggies are tender and tofu is warmed through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide tofu-veggie bake between plates or bowls and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Transfer to a large bowl and pat dry with paper towels. Add cheese, hot sauce, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled blue cheese
½ cup hot sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide bean filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Fold tortillas in half to close. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.

Meanwhile, wash, dry and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Wipe the reserved bowl clean with paper towels (if desired); place lettuce, carrots, and vinaigrette in the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 hearts romaine hearts
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
½ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans.
Peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the onions are soft, add garlic and crushed red pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, and broth to the pot. Bring the soup to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until slightly thickened, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1774 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.
When the soup is slightly thickened, add orzo. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is almost tender, 5-6 minutes more.

When the orzo is almost done, add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale and orzo are tender, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and drizzle with oil. Enjoy!
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and veggie ground to the pot; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, frozen veggies, tomatoes, soy sauce, and spices to the pot, then stir to combine the soup. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until the veggies are soft, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
7 ½ cups frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the soup and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat two large baking dishes with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)

Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with beef, coconut aminos, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Using a generous tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs. Divide between the baking dishes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 tbsp coconut aminos
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a clean large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice bacon.
When the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-6 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add cabbage and spices to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide meatballs and bacon-fried cabbage between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: While the water is heating, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
6 sticks celery
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Set remaining green onions aside for serving.)
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain tomatoes in a colander. Set aside to drain further.
When the veggies are tender, add flour to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, soy sauce, and hot sauce to the pan, then stir to combine the stew. Cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
When the stew has thickened, add beans and cream to the pot, then stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the bean stew between bowls. Place a scoop of rice in the center of each bowl and top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!
Place veggie ground, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices in a large bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, place ketchup and crushed red pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a clean large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrot into noodle-like strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with pine nuts, and toss to combine the salad.
Toast the buns if desired.
Spread spicy ketchup over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of salad. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, 18-20 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in a large pot.

Add orzo, broth, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the pot with the thyme. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
425 g orzo pasta
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the orzo is cooking, finely grate mozzarella. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
When the onions are caramelized, carefully transfer them to the pot with the orzo. Stir to combine. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Add spinach to the pot with the orzo in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return to medium-high heat and continue to cook until spinach is completely wilted, 3-4 minutes more.
Once the spinach is wilted, remove from heat, sprinkle with grated cheese, and cover with a lid. Set aside until cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, return skillet used for the onions to medium-high heat. Add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add bread slices and pan-fry until toasted on one side, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
6 slices sourdough bread

instructions.primary_message: Remove bread to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return bread to the skillet, toasted-side up, and continue to pan-fry until toasted on the other side, 1 minute more. Return to the plate.
Divide orzo between plates or bowls. Serve with toasted sourdough on the side and enjoy!
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg green beans
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce to medium-low and simmer until beans are fork-tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Divide between a medium and a large bowl. Set the medium bowl aside for later use.

Add veggie ground, eggs, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices to the large bowl with the onion. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Use a scant ¼-cup measure to form the veggie ground mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the onion (reserving a small handful for serving).
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, mayo, water and spices, then stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters and green beans between plates or bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce and sprinkle with reserved mint. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the leek.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.

When the veggies are softened, add beans, tomato sauce, water, and soy sauce to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
¾ cup water
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the sauce is slightly thickened, transfer bean mixture to a large baking dish, then top with cheese. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the bake is done, divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
To serve, divide cheesy bean bake and toast between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Quarter mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, thyme, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, orzo, and soy sauce to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
425 g orzo pasta
2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Place on a plate, then sprinkle both sides with cornstarch and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and pan-fry until golden brown and warmed through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
To serve, divide tofu and orzo between plates. Enjoy!

Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Place in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash, peel, and small dice carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion, carrots, and ground beef. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Transfer beef and vegetables to a colander and set aside.
Return skillet to stove. Add butter and flour; whisk until smooth. Add broth and soy sauce. Bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Return beef and vegetables to skillet. Add peas, salt, and pepper. Mix well and cook until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup frozen peas
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add butter, broth, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place beef and veggie mixture in a bowl or on a plate, top with mashed potatoes, and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice potatoes.
Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onions; peel, trim, and small dice carrots.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the onion and carrot. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are soft, add veggie ground to the skillet, along with half of the parsley and spices (reserving remaining parsley for garnish). Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high.
Peel and mince garlic.
When the veggie ground is done, add garlic and soy sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes.

Add flour and tomato paste to the skillet; stir well, then add broth, peas, and corn. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
3 tbsp tomato paste
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup frozen peas
¾ cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain and return to the pot. Add broth, oil, garlic powder, and salt; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the veggie ground mixture to a large baking dish and spread evenly; top with mashed potatoes. Place in the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes begin to brown.
To serve, divide the Shepherd's pie between plates and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
